cells.gaps: No share of adults holding either a bank or an electronic money account has been found, so 53% is not shown; the Findex fieldwork left out Cabo Delgado and some districts.
cells.note: The Banco de Moçambique report, citing Global Findex 2025, puts adults with an electronic money account at 46% and with a bank account at 25%. The overlap is not given, so the share holding either is not shown to reach 53%.
